findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dcl_evaluate_signal · Private data: dcl_evaluate_secrets, dcl_audit_decode, dcl_evaluate_jailbreak_crypto, dcl_evaluate_wallet, dcl_evaluate_signal, dcl_evaluate_output_sanitizer, dcl_commit · Public sink: dcl_evaluate_secrets, dcl_evaluate_pii, dcl_audit_decode, dcl_audit_decode_deep, dcl_evaluate_wallet, dcl_evaluate_mev, dcl_evaluate_signal, dcl_evaluate_output_sanitizer · Destructive: dcl_evaluate_jailbreak_crypto, dcl_evaluate_wallet, dcl_evaluate_output_sanitizer, dcl_commit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dcl_evaluate_signal · Private data: dcl_evaluate_secrets, dcl_audit_decode, dcl_evaluate_jailbreak_crypto, dcl_evaluate_wallet, dcl_evaluate_signal, dcl_evaluate_output_sanitizer, dcl_commit · Public sink: dcl_evaluate_secrets, dcl_evaluate_pii, dcl_audit_decode, dcl_audit_decode_deep, dcl_evaluate_wallet, dcl_evaluate_mev, dcl_evaluate_signal, dcl_evaluate_output_sanitizer · Destructive: dcl_evaluate_jailbreak_crypto, dcl_evaluate_wallet, dcl_evaluate_output_sanitizer, dcl_commit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
